verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the product ships editable, pre-built SKILL.md files (with name/description frontmatter visible in probes) that users can copy and 'make their own,' but there is no documented template or authoring guide for creating a brand-new skill from scratch — the only scaffolding skill described (setup-matt-pocock-skills) configures per-repo settings like issue trackers and labels, not skill authoring itself. Without such a template, a developer would have to reverse-engineer an existing SKILL.md to author a new one, which is exactly what the story asks to avoid.
